Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description: Job Title: Senior Data Analyst Location: Guadalajara, Hybrid This is a hybrid position, which will require the ability to be onsite in our Guadalajara, Mexico office as needed. Candidates must be based in Guadalajara. ABOUT THE COMPANY: Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we’re building the industry’s first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth. With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate. Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future. THE OPPORTUNITY: At Salesloft, our Senior Data Analysts turn data into the decisions that keep the company secure and running well. You will analyze security, operational, and business data to surface insight, quantify risk, and give the teams you support the evidence they need to act. Your analysis directly shapes how leaders understand and respond to what the data is telling them. This is a high-impact analytics role. You will build the reports, dashboards, and analyses that make complex security and operational data understandable and actionable, dig into questions that matter, and help the organization measure what's working. As AI reshapes both the threat landscape and how we work, your analysis helps the team see clearly and prioritize. On a day-to-day basis, you will: Analyze security, operational, and business data to surface insight, quantify risk, and answer the questions that matter. Build and maintain reports and dashboards that make complex data clear and actionable for technical and non-technical audiences. Partner with security, IT, and business stakeholders to define metrics and measure what's working. Investigate anomalies and trends in the data, translating findings into clear recommendations. Improve data quality and the analytical models behind the metrics you own. Communicate findings crisply, turning analysis into decisions leaders can act on. This role lives at the heart of how we practice Evidence Over Ego — you are, quite literally, the evidence function: you bring rigorous, honest analysis to decisions that would otherwise be made on instinct. And in the spirit of how we are Customer Inspired — where every decision has a true north, and it's our customer — the clarity you bring to security and operational data is part of how we protect the trust customers place in us. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR: We are looking for an experienced analyst who turns messy data into clear, trustworthy insight and communicates it in a way that drives action. You are rigorous with data and thoughtful about how you present it. You embody what we call Evidence Over Ego — bringing honest, data-grounded analysis is the entire job, and you are candid about what the data does and doesn't support. You are curious, rigorous, and motivated by helping teams make better decisions. This is the right role if you want your analysis to directly shape how a category-defining company operates and stays secure. THE TEAM: The Salesloft Security and data organization protects and governs the data the company and its customers depend on, and Senior Data Analysts turn that data into insight and decisions. The team works closely with Security, IT, and business stakeholders. The team Moves as One — analysts, security, IT, and business partners share ownership of data-driven decisions and coordinate directly. And we are relentlessly Customer Inspired: our customers' success is the only scorecard that matters, and clear, honest analysis of security and operational data is part of how we protect the company and its customers. THE SKILL SET: Strong experience as a data analyst, with a track record of turning data into actionable insight. Proficiency in SQL and experience with BI and data visualization tools, Sigma experience a plus (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BI). Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with rigor around data quality and interpretation. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to make complex data clear to technical and non-technical audiences. Experience partnering with stakeholders to define metrics and answer business questions. Experience analyzing security, risk, or operational data. Proficiency in Python or R for deeper analysis preferred. Familiarity with cloud data platforms and modern warehouse/lakehouse tooling. At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you’re excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us! Please note that all official communication regarding job opportunities at Salesloft will come from @ salesloft.com email address. If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. To verify the authenticity of any job-related communication, please visit our official Careers Page. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, notetaking, or summarizing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment — all hiring decisions are made by people. Opting out will not impact your experience or consideration.

Title: Associate Staff Engineer - Data Analyst
Description: Company Description We are a Digital Product Engineering company that is scaling in a big way! We build products, services, and experiences that inspire, excite, and delight. We work at scale — across all devices and digital mediums, and our people exist everywhere in the world (15000+ experts across 26 countries, to be exact). Our work culture is dynamic and non-hierarchical. We are looking for great new colleagues. That is where you come in! Job Description Role and Responsibility: Build Dashboards & Reports: Design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards and reports in Tableau and/or Power BI that deliver actionable insights to business stakeholders. Own the full lifecycle from requirements gathering to published, production-grade visualizations. Data Analysis & Storytelling: Analyze manufacturing, operational, and financial data to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities. Translate findings into clear, compelling visual narratives that drive decision-making across teams. SQL & Data Exploration: Write SQL queries in Snowflake to extract, transform, and validate data for reporting. Perform ad-hoc analyses to answer business questions and support strategic initiatives. Support Data Modeling: Collaborate with data engineers to define reporting requirements and contribute to dbt model development — building or modifying staging and mart models that feed dashboards and reports. Analytical Mindset: Strong attention to detail with the ability to spot data inconsistencies, ask the right questions, and deliver accurate, trustworthy reporting. Documentation & Training: Document data definitions, metric calculations, and dashboard usage guides. Provide training and support to business users to promote self-service analytics adoption. Expectation from the Candidate: Experience: 2+ years of experience in a data analyst, BI analyst, or reporting analyst role with a portfolio of dashboards and reports delivered to business stakeholders. Technical Prowess: Strong proficiency in Tableau and/or Power BI: calculated fields, LOD expressions (Tableau), DAX measures (Power BI), parameters, dynamic filters, row-level security, and performance optimization. Working knowledge of SQL for querying Snowflake: JOINs, CTEs, window functions, aggregations, and basic data transformation. Foundational understanding of dbt: ability to read and modify existing models, understand the staging/mart layer structure, and run dbt commands for testing and documentation. Familiarity with data modeling concepts: star schemas, fact/dimension tables, and how they translate into efficient dashboard data sources. Basic Python skills for data wrangling, automation, or extending analytics workflows (pandas, notebooks). Qualifications Must have skills: Power BI (Strong), Snowflake, Tableau (Strong) Good to have skills: DBT, Python (Capable)

Title: Master Data Engineer – Automation & Data Operations
Description: We’re Hiring: Master Data Engineer – Automation & Data Operations Location: Guadalajara, Mexico Role Level: Specialist About the Role Clean customer and order data is the critical dependency across our enterprise CRM and CPQ transformation roadmap. Today, too many rule-based decisions and data corrections are handled manually. This is a build role, not a queue-processing role. We are looking for a Master Data Engineer who designs, configures, and automates matching, merging, hierarchy resolution, and validation logic in Salesforce. In this position, data remediation is the method used to test, validate, and tune the automation logic—not a static backlog to absorb. Success is measured by driving manual touchpoints down and system throughput up. What You’ll Do Build Salesforce Automation: Design, build, and deploy matching, merging, deduplication, and validation rules in Salesforce (SFDC) to systematically eliminate manual touches and recurring defect patterns. Master Complex Hierarchies & Identifiers: Configure logic for parent–child, reseller, distributor, and end-customer relationships, as well as critical account-assignment checks (e.g., OPSI assignment rules). AI & Automated Matching: Implement automated and AI-assisted workflows for missing-data detection, account-matching assistance, and order classification. Validate on Production Populations: Run rule sets against live account and order records to evaluate precision and recall; baseline and prove performance metrics (match precision, manual touches per order, defect rate reductions) before release. Manage Residual Queues & Convert Patterns: Handle unautomated residual queues (e.g., complex indirect orders) while actively converting repeating defects into persistent validation rules to shrink operational queues over time. Technical Documentation & Governance: Author functionality specifications, data-model impact documentation, and acceptance test evidence inside Jira following agile delivery practices. Support Enterprise Initiatives: Partner with cross-functional teams (Product Owners, Solution Architects, SFDC Developers, Sales Ops, BI) supporting initiatives like enterprise territory alignments, Customer 360, and recurring billing enablement. What You Bring Experience: 5–8 years of hands-on experience in master data management (MDM), data operations, or CRM data quality within large-scale enterprise environments. Salesforce Build Capabilities: Deep technical configuration skills in Salesforce—Flows, duplicate/matching rules, validation rules, bulk data loading/operations, and reporting. Automation & Scripting: Proficiency in Python (or equivalent scripting language) with practical experience applying automation or ML logic to classification and matching problems. Data Remediation at Scale: Proven track record of cleaning and restructuring large volumes of customer, account, or order data, backed by measurable metric improvements. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Strong professional communication in English (written and verbal), comfortable working across global stakeholders across AMS, EMEA, and APJ. Bonus Points If You Have Prior experience with enterprise channel data structures and master identifiers (e.g., OPSI, BPID, HPD, OSS). Experience in Fortune 100 or global enterprise CRM/CPQ and order management ecosystems. Salesforce Certifications ( Administrator , Platform App Builder , or Data Architect ). Experience working in Jira and TestRail under structured sprint cycles. Interested in engineering out manual work and scaling enterprise data systems?

Title: Analista Senior de Transporte y Distribución Heavy & Bulky - Mercado Envíos
Description: En Mercado Libre estamos democratizando el comercio y los servicios financieros para transformar la vida de las personas de América Latina. ¡Sumate a este propósito! En Mercado Envíos administramos el inventario de quienes venden en nuestra plataforma y entregamos los productos a quienes compran, mejorando su experiencia. En un mundo en constante evolución, nuestra capacidad para entregar rápidamente los productos que se compran a través de Mercado Libre se ha convertido en un requisito para competir. Dan el máximo porque les gusta trabajar con compromiso y dedicación. Viven los cambios como oportunidades y aprenden de sus errores. La excelencia y la ejecución son claves en su forma de hacer las cosas. Promueven el buen clima, aportan alegría y diversión. Saben cómo construir con otras personas y disfrutan trabajando en equipo. Imagínate emprendiendo proyectos desafiantes, dinámicos e innovadores y siendo responsable de: Diagnóstico estratégico y planes de acción: Transformar métricas clave (DS, Visit Success, Delay, ORH, Daños) en acciones concretas para elevar la eficiencia logística y asegurar entregas impecables. Inteligencia de datos y dashboards: Diseñar reportes dinámicos en BigQuery y Last Mile Tools para facilitar la toma de decisiones basada en datos para supervisores y gerencia. Resolución de causa raíz: Liderar la corrección de desviaciones operativas coordinando a Team Leaders y áreas transversales para implementar soluciones permanentes. Estandarización y cultura operacional: Gestionar y actualizar los SOPs del site H&B Dedicado para garantizar la consistencia en todos los turnos. Alineación de rutinas de gestión: Auditar el Ops Clock, TIER 1, Fast Audit e inventarios para cerrar brechas operativas y asegurar la ejecución diaria. Optimización de entregas y formación técnica: Validar modelos de última milla (Rentals, Crowd, MLP) y capacitar al equipo en herramientas analíticas y metodologías de mejora continua (Lean, Kaizen, PDCA).
